what: CynCo's embedding service on 127.0.0.1:9165 was down while the engine depended on it (docs/cynco-failure-log.md F215). Nothing sampled the port that day: the reporter did not exist. These are the two times that real records give, and how firmly.

saidDown.basis: the engine's own log line; the log carries no times, and the line sits 39 lines above the index stamp 2026-11-11T15:06:00.871Z of the same engine start

back.basis: F215 in the failure log: the service was started by hand at 10:18:12 local, read from the task's last-run time that day; no log line records it

notEstablished: When the service stopped answering. Its 49-hour run ended with the planned restart (the System log: shutdown 09:47:06Z, three boots by 09:49:41Z); nobody was logged on until 14:59:00Z, so nothing of CynCo ran and nothing depended on it in between. What stopped its start at logon is not known (Task Scheduler's history log is disabled).
Any reading of the port between the two times. The fixture carries no sample for the outage: only the engine's words that open it and the recorded restart that closes it.
